propositions: Mapping configuration must be parsed as a reserved section in the config schema, not coerced through JiraConfig, to avoid unknown-key warnings and errors.

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) deep-merge per key across layers (built-in ← default ← project-specific), while vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) replace wholesale at the most-specific layer without unioning.

All axis-map values must validate offline against the effective vocabulary set at config load time, rejecting out-of-vocabulary entries, malformed blocks, and references to absent capabilities; the sole non-vocabulary value allowed is the 'skip' sentinel.

A provider-neutral Capability descriptor dataclass must declare which mapping axes a target supports (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) without importing any Jira adapter code.
Configuration loading must fail closed with a new MappingConfigError subclass when validation fails, following the same config error path as other schema violations.
Mapping configuration and per-project store identity (.bridge_state/projects.json) are orthogonal concerns joined on the same Jira project key without duplicating identity data.
